newsitem.title: USA: Apple looking outside for technology.
newsitem.headline: Apple looking outside for technology.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc's chief technology officer Ellen Hancock confirmed Tuesday the company is looking outside for technology to bolster its software development efforts.
"We're ending Apple's go-it-alone, not-invented-here mentality," Hancock said at a technology briefing at Comdex.
Apple, the struggling number three computer maker, earlier this year shelved plans to rewrite its vaunted MacIntosh operating system -- the fundamental program that controls its personal computers.
Apple is considering buying or licensing technology from outside software developers to get its development efforts going again. Speculation has centered around privately held Be Inc.
Hancock would not confirm speculation about buyout talks with Be, but she suggested that Apple is negotiating with several companies for technology.
Her comments came at the Comdex computing trade show here.
